task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the blue cream cheese block on the table.
Reach the open gripper across the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table beside the bowl.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table, away from the metal bowl.
Carry the blue cream cheese box horizontally over the table toward the metal bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and open the gripper.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the open gripper upward.
Retract the open gripper upward from above the bowl containing the cream cheese.
